problem_type: Explicit model selection lost behind restored SDK configuration
symptom: Selecting another model or provider on an existing conversation reopens the lane but subsequent turns retain the old model identity and never reach the newly selected endpoint.
direct_cause: AgentHarness options.model only seeds new lanes. Restored lane configuration wins, while openLane never calls the public setModel method for the explicit Nomi selection.
class_root: The shared host does not distinguish a constructor seed, an explicit changed selection, and reopening the same persisted model identity.
affected_population: Cold reopen with an explicit model selection
entry_points: Direct host open of an existing lane

external_sources.purpose: Installed 0.85.1 dist/harness/runtime/harness.js lines 87-113 and 278-291 confirm seed-only constructor model semantics and restoration of persisted lane configuration.
Installed public AgentLane.setModel declaration and runtime/lane.js lines 1282-1291 update the durable model identity while spreading the remaining configuration.

invariants: Every executing lane binds the explicit Nomi-selected model through the SDK's public configuration API before exposing its projection or accepting input.
Model selection preserves transcript, session identity and SDK-persisted activeToolNames.
Model or provider replacement uses the selected endpoint and model on the actual request.
Reopening an unchanged provider/model identity performs no configuration write and preserves saved bytes, updatedAt and list ordering.
generality_proof: Both workspace model replacement and direct or cold host openings converge on openLane, independent of provider, protocol or whether the session already exists.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Bind the explicitly supplied model after acquiring the SDK lane and before publishing or executing it.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Workspace closes and reopens the same lane with the new selection; real HTTP regressions cover both same-provider model and cross-protocol provider changes.
Direct host reopen must replace only the stored model identity while retaining tools actually added by a previous SDK tool result.
History has no configured model and does not execute turns; it remains available without credentials.

recurrence.reason: Every persisted lane can retain a stale constructor seed after an explicit selection, regardless of the selected provider or model.
same_class_scan: Inspected configureModel -> switchTo -> openLane and cold workspace construction.
Searched production setModel/setActiveTools uses and checked SDK restoration versus constructor seed behavior.
Checked saved history opening and real addedToolNames restoration for state that must not be reset.

prevention.invariant: The executing SDK lane model identity equals the explicit Nomi-selected provider and model.
prevention.failure_mode: A rejected public model update rejects host construction before any user input is accepted, with existing cleanup releasing resources.
prevention.strategy: Read current model identity through the public SDK API and call setModel only when provider or modelId differs; leave persisted active-tool configuration untouched.

legacy_paths.rationale: The existing host attachment path is repaired in place; no fallback or alternate host is added.

dependency_lifecycle.target: A supported pi release preserving explicit durable lane configuration APIs.
dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Seed-only construction is deliberate SDK behavior. Nomi must explicitly apply the user's selected model through setModel.
exit_criteria: Rerun actual HTTP selection, provider change, cold reopen and added-tool retention fixtures on any SDK configuration API upgrade.
Same-model reopen must preserve exact JSONL bytes and public session metadata including updatedAt.

migration: No format migration. Existing lane model configuration is updated through the public API on normal execution attachment; transcript and tools remain intact.
residual_risks: The parent owns the real Electron model-picker walkthrough; these tests prove the actual production workspace and host reach the selected HTTP model.

invariant_owner_layer.why: This is the first common owner receiving both a persisted SDK lane and the explicit current model selection.
